TurretPack.summary: The Ion Turret is a light, fast-firing turret that shoots small explosive ion bolts.
notes: Fires IonBolt (Energy damage, 4 m blast) every 0.4 s out to 55 m. Energy damage has no extra effect in Apteryx.
Deploys anywhere, including walls and ceilings, under the shared turret rules. Only the Scorpion can carry it. Team limit 2.

Unlike this wiki's Total Annihilation release, it has no help text on mount (TA's says the bolts disable shields, jetpacks and energy weapons), and the team limit is 2 instead of TA's 10. Range, fire rate and placement are the same.

FlameTurretPack.summary: The Flame Turret is an indoor short-range turret that streams burning plasma. It is deployed with a fuel canister behind it.
notes: Fires FlameShell (Plasma damage, 3 m blast) every 0.02 s out to 20 m. Plasma damage sets players burning, which is only visual.
Can only be deployed inside buildings (on an InteriorShape), on a flat floor between 2.75 m and 3.5 m away. It cannot be within 40% of the flag distance of the enemy flag, or near other turrets.
A 'Flame Turret Fuel' canister is placed 0.8 m behind the turret. Destroying either one sets the other to 0.6 damage. The canister explodes with debris damage when destroyed.
Only the Scorpion can carry it. Team limit 2.
Script bug: the deployer is recorded on %obj, a leftover variable holding the object type of the deploy surface, instead of on the turret.

Unlike this wiki's Total Annihilation release, it is restricted to buildings (TA comments that check out), deploys from 3.5 m instead of 5 m, reaches 20 m instead of 30 m, and is tougher (maxDamage 1.05 against 0.55).

NuclearTurretPack.summary: The EMP Turret fires slow EMP rockets that strip enemies of their energy.
notes: Fires the EMP rocket (Shock damage, 11.5 m blast) every 2.5 s out to 35 m. Shock damage zeroes a victim's energy, then keeps draining it for about 3 s per hit (Armor::onShock).
Deploys anywhere, including walls and ceilings, under the shared turret rules. Only the Scorpion can carry it. Team limit 2.
Unlike this wiki's Total Annihilation release, where this datablock is the 'Nuclear Turret'.

notes: Fires LightLaser (Laser damage) out to 75 m, once a second, each shot needing 55 energy.
Ground only: it must sit on a flat surface. Touching it puts a team player in manual control, standing on the turret ($CanControl, $EmbedController).
When destroyed it sets off a large debris blast (20 m).
Only the Scorpion can carry it. Team limit 2.
Unlike this wiki's Total Annihilation release, where this datablock is the 'Plasma Turret'.

FusionTurretPack.summary: The MFAC Turret is a long-range, slow-firing cannon turret that shoots the MFAC round. It can also be aimed by hand.
notes: Fires the MFAC bullet (Shotgun damage) every 2 s out to 120 m.
Ground only. Touching it puts a team player in manual control, standing on the turret.
When destroyed it sets off a large debris blast (20 m).
Only the Scorpion (and the unsold Commando) can carry it. Team limit 2.
Unlike this wiki's Total Annihilation release, where this datablock is the 'Fusion Turret'.

RocketPack.summary: The Missile Turret launches homing missiles at hot targets: jetting players and vehicles.
notes: Fires TurretMissile (Missile damage, 9.5 m blast), a seeking missile, every 2.5 s out to 135 m. verifyTarget accepts only targets with a heat factor of at least 0.5.
Ground only. It cannot be controlled by hand. When destroyed it sets off a large debris blast (20 m).
Only the Scorpion can carry it. Team limit 2.

Unlike this wiki's Total Annihilation release, it is shorter-ranged (135 m instead of 250 m), fires faster (2.5 s instead of 3.5 s) and is tougher (maxDamage 2.65 against 1.25). It fires TurretMissile instead of TurretMissileDeployed and has no help text on mount. Its team limit is 2 instead of 3.

notes: Fires MortarTurretShell (Mortar damage, 30 m blast) every 2 s. Its range is only 10 m, and the mount text says it 'has no auto-sensor and must be controlled manually to fire'.

$CanControl is 0, so touching it does not take control. It can only be run from the command map through Turret::onAttemptControl, which needs a Command Station. That function also accepts a Laptop, but Apteryx defines no Laptop item.
Ground only. Only the Scorpion can carry it. Team limit 2.
Unlike this wiki's Total Annihilation release, where this datablock is the 'Mortar Turret'.

notes: Fires IonGatling bullets (Energy damage) every 0.1 s. Its range is 0, so it never fires on its own ('Deployable chaingun, must be manually controlled').

ParticleBeamTurretPack.summary: The Energy Artillery Turret is a manually aimed version of the Energy Artillery cannon. Each shot charges for several seconds and then fires a devastating artillery shell.
notes: Its range is 0, so it never fires on its own. Touching it puts a team player in control, standing on the turret.
ParticleBeamTurret::onFire works only when the turret is not reloading and has at least 185 energy. It spends 100 energy and starts the charge-up. Energy max is 200 and recharges at 15.

The charge-up spawns zero-damage ArtilleryEffect bursts at the muzzle every 0.3 s. TurretArtilleryRevUp hands off to the handheld weapon's ArtilleryRevUp after its first step, so the handheld 21-step count applies, and the ArtilleryShell (Missile damage, 17.5 m blast) fires after about 6 s.
Ground only. Only the Scorpion (and the unsold Commando) can carry it. Team limit 2.
New in Apteryx: this wiki's Total Annihilation release names ParticleBeamTurretPack only in its item-limit table and defines no such item.
